answer: Operator-Linked Liability Mirror. Each agent wallet maps to a verified operator; a sybil cluster detected by graph analysis triggers a mirror penalty on the operator's primary account—loss of a posted collateral reserve and throttled throughput across all their wallets. An honest operator's reserve reflects a vertex in the trust graph, so costs scale with distinct operators, not wallets. Reaching real influence requires many independent operators, pushing attack cost toward a linear summit per identity.
